text.p: Manchester Equipment Co Inc said on Monday it had completed the acquisition of Electrograph Systems Inc for $2.5 million in cash.
Manchester also assumed about $350,000 of liabilities owed by Electrograph to its parent company Bitwise Designs Inc, Manchester said in a statement.
The parties announced on March 11 that they had signed a letter of intent, and earlier this month they said the contract had been signed.
Manchester said the acquired assets had been contributed to a newly formed subsidiary that will also be called Electrograph Systems Inc.
Electrograph, a reseller of computer graphic and display monitors, had annual sales for its fiscal year ended June 30 of about $16 million, Manchester said.
Manchester Equipment Co Inc is a systems integrator and reseller of computer hardware, software and networking products.
